sections_en.text: This document shows the P1 maintenance steps for the conventional gas circuit breaker 220 kV, which must be carried out every 8 years as indicated above by the code Y8. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ibrahim Ibrahim Shehata at the Suez Cement substation, Canal West networks.

items: Open a work order approved by the competent authority
Fence the work area and place warning signs.

sections_en.text: Helmet and safety shoes, gas leakage detection device

items: Helmet and safety shoes, gas leakage detection device

sections_en.text: Work steps to be carried out

items: Check the gas pressure and make sure the gas readings are correct; in case of incorrect readings, test the manometer and carry out a gas leakage check with the appropriate device
Take the readings of the operation counter
Extract the SF6 gas from the switch using machine D:10

Open the interrupting unit of one phase and inspect the contact and make sure of its condition; it is replaced in case of heavy wear, and in case of replacing the contact all the interrupting units are opened
Change the filters
Inspect and clean the auxiliary contacts and oil them, as well as the loading areas, and grease the connecting parts
Refill the gas
Check the oil level
Test all the connections in the oil pipes and make sure there is no leakage in them
Drain the oil and clean the oil tank and the filter
Fill the oil again
The initial pressure reading of the nitrogen gas is measured from the oil side
Raise the pressure in the storage cylinder to the normal pressure and measure the pump current at that pressure
Operate the On-Off switch
The minimum pressure required for operation is measured
Measure the minimum voltage required to operate the On-Off coils
Test the operating pressure of the safety valve
Test the pressure and density measuring group B1, B2, B3, B4
Test the control and signalling group
Test the gas and oil manometers
Measure the consumption of the heaters (anti-condensation)
Carry out the pole discrepancy test: in case of opening one phase only, the other two phases are opened (Enforced triple-pole operating feature and the anti-pumping feature)
Tighten all the terminals in the control cables as well as all the bolts on the breaker

Introduction
This document shows the P1 maintenance steps for the conventional gas circuit breaker 220 kV, which must be carried out every 8 years as indicated above by the code Y8. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ibrahim Ibrahim Shehata at the Suez Cement substation, Canal West networks.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order approved by the competent authority
Fence the work area and place warning signs.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Helmet and safety shoes, gas leakage detection device
Helmet and safety shoes, gas leakage detection device
Work steps to be carried out
Check the gas pressure and make sure the gas readings are correct; in case of incorrect readings, test the manometer and carry out a gas leakage check with the appropriate device
Take the readings of the operation counter
Extract the SF6 gas from the switch using machine D:10
Open the interrupting unit of one phase and inspect the contact and make sure of its condition; it is replaced in case of heavy wear, and in case of replacing the contact all the interrupting units are opened
Change the filters
Inspect and clean the auxiliary contacts and oil them, as well as the loading areas, and grease the connecting parts
Refill the gas
Check the oil level
Test all the connections in the oil pipes and make sure there is no leakage in them
Drain the oil and clean the oil tank and the filter
Fill the oil again
The initial pressure reading of the nitrogen gas is measured from the oil side
Raise the pressure in the storage cylinder to the normal pressure and measure the pump current at that pressure
Operate the On-Off switch
The minimum pressure required for operation is measured
Measure the minimum voltage required to operate the On-Off coils
Test the operating pressure of the safety valve
Test the pressure and density measuring group B1, B2, B3, B4
Test the control and signalling group
Test the gas and oil manometers
Measure the consumption of the heaters (anti-condensation)
Carry out the pole discrepancy test: in case of opening one phase only, the other two phases are opened (Enforced triple-pole operating feature and the anti-pumping feature)
Tighten all the terminals in the control cables as well as all the bolts on the breaker
